item.title: A clean MLE derivation
item.description:
We’ll solve for $\hat\theta$ from $\ell’(\hat\theta)=0$ and show the asymptotic normality:

$$ \sqrt{n},(\hat\theta-\theta_0)\xrightarrow{d}\mathcal{N}!\bigl(0, I(\theta_0)^{-1}\bigr).\tag{1} $$

Theorem 1.
Under regularity conditions, (1) holds by the MLE central limit theorem.
Proof.
Use Taylor around $\theta_0$ and the LLN/CLT for the score.
▢
